prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / matching companion card. Create ONE QUEEN OF CLUBS using the supplied Design 2 Queen of Spades as the authoritative visual reference. Preserve the exact 5:7 full-card composition, small elegant head-and-torso scale, broad graceful sleeves spanning the inner sides, Ming-inspired madder-red silk phoenix robe with gold cloud embroidery, teal-and-gold lotus-embroidered stole bands/cuffs, ivory inner collar, jade plaque belt, black upswept hair, compact gold-and-teal phoenix crown with pearls and red gemstones. Same naturalistic painted adult Chinese royal woman style, refined face and hands, luminous restrained shading, no facial hair. All four Queens share the same rich clothing palette; do not recolor the whole woman by suit.
Preserve the narrow gold lotus-vine outer frame, beaded inner rules, ivory margin and diagonal ivory index panels; dense teal/red/ivory/gold Chinese lotus ornament on BLACK interior ground, shaped ivory reserve with fine gold tracery, diagonal woven waist join and SMALL turquoise jewel at exact card center. Retain motif scale and density; no empty background or enlarged figure. Crown and every attribute safely inside the inner frame.
Exactly two opposing waist-up portraits of the SAME woman, with the bottom a precise 180-degree rotated counterpart of the upper. Same face, crown, hands, flower, robe, ornament and index under a half turn. Natural diagonal central join. Two hands per upright figure, graceful correct fingers; no extra inherited hands or staff parts.
Change the two corner indices to serif Q and the specified small PLAIN SOLID suit symbol, keeping the letter size, clear Q tail, panel positioning and rotated lower copy. No K letters, no names, captions or other text. One flat full-card PNG approximately 1060x1484, no mockup, other cards, scene, border-crossing ornaments, photo, anime, 3D or watermark.

CLUBS: Retain BLACK outer frame and BLACK interior floral ground. Black serif Q above a plain solid black CLUB trefoil (three round lobes and short stem) in the upper-left panel, matching rotated index at bottom-right.
MANDATORY PORTRAIT DIRECTION CHANGE: turn the UPRIGHT queen's face toward VIEWER'S LEFT, nose pointing toward the upper-left Q, BOTH EYES visible in gentle three-quarter view. Do not retain the reference's rightward gaze. A distinct adult Chinese woman with softly rounded cheeks, slightly broader face than Spades, calm brown eyes and a subtle serene smile. Black hair neatly swept into a braided court updo. A compact gold/teal Ming-inspired phoenix crown with small rounded red jewels, pearl details and shorter temple pendants; not a European crown or Qing headdress.
REMOVE the scepter entirely, including all staff ornaments and dangling beads. In one hand near shoulder height hold a SMALL LIVING FLOWER SPRIG: one ivory blossom with red-tipped rounded layered petals, one small unopened red bud, and two slender green leaves on a natural slim green stem. Main flower about 6% of card width, never an oversized bouquet. Fingers gently hold the slender stem, which is visible below the hand. Other hand lightly gathers the embroidered mantle on her upper chest. Preserve madder-red phoenix robe, broad graceful sleeves, teal-and-gold lotus bands, all surrounding patterns and same reduced figure scale.
Lower figure and flower are the exact 180-degree counterpart, same woman and same attributes. Maintain exact 5:7 aspect, target 1060x1484.
